entities.name: Eva Hagenbäumer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eva Hagenbäumer is a former field hockey player from Germany, who was a member of the national squad that won the silver medal at the 1992 Summer Olympics in Barcelona, Spain. She competed in two consecutive Summer Olympics for her native country, starting in 1992.
